SELECT DISTINCT
		a.created_by AS USER_ID
		,'' AS USER_NAME		
		,'' AS mobile_phone		
		, '' AS email_addr		
		, 'KO' language_code		
		, A.DIVISION_ID		AS SEGMENT1
		, A.customer		AS SEGMENT2
		, A.from_site_code	AS SEGMENT3	
		, A.to_site_code	AS SEGMENT4	
		, A.INCOTERMS		AS SEGMENT5
		, 'Division'		AS COLUMN1
		, 'Customer'		AS COLUMN2
		, 'From Site'		AS COLUMN3
		, 'To Site'			AS COLUMN4
		, 'Incoterms'			AS COLUMN5
 FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT T.*
  FROM (
        SELECT
  		 ma.division_id		
         ,bo.bod_id
  		,dbo.fn_get_division_name (ma.division_id) AS division_name		
  		,dbo.FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(ma.division_id,ma.SCM_SITE_ID,'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION') AS customer
  		,ma.incoterms		
  		,ma.PLANT_SITE_ID AS from_site_code		
  		--,ISNULL(dbo.fn_get_scm_site_description (ma.division_id, ma.PLANT_SITE_ID) , '-') AS from_site_name		
  		,ma.SCM_SITE_ID AS to_site_code		
  		--,ISNULL(dbo.fn_get_scm_site_description (ma.division_id, ma.SCM_SITE_ID) , '-') AS to_site_name		
  		,bo.safety_stock, bo.priority		
  		,bo.valid_yn as bod_valid		
  		,ro.valid_yn as route_valid		
  		,ro.route_id		
  		,ro.days_mon		
  		,ro.days_tue		
  		,ro.days_wed		
  		,ro.days_thu		
  		,ro.days_fri		
  		,ro.days_sat		
  		,ro.days_sun		
  		,(select v.lt_total from scp_mst_bod_v v where v.division_id = ma.division_id  and v.BOD_ID = bo.bod_id ) AS lead_time		
  		,ISNULL(bo.created_by,ma.created_by)  created_by		
		
  		FROM  (		
		select [DIVISION_ID],[PROJECT_CODE],[SCM_SITE_ID] ,[ITEM_ID],[DOM_EXP] ,[FCST_TYPE] ,[INCOTERMS] ,[MEASURE],  [PLANT_SITE_ID] ,[YYYYMMDD] ,[PLAN_QTY] ,[BOD_ID] ,[CREATED_BY]          
		 from (
		   SELECT [DIVISION_ID] 
			  ,[PROJECT_CODE] 
			  ,[SCM_SITE_ID] 
			  ,[ITEM_ID]  
			  ,[DOM_EXP]  
			  ,[FCST_TYPE]  
			  ,[INCOTERMS]  
			  ,[MEASURE]  
			  ,CASE WHEN R.[PLANT_SITE_ID] IS NULL OR R.[PLANT_SITE_ID] = '' THEN 'KR012031-P' ELSE R.[PLANT_SITE_ID] END AS [PLANT_SITE_ID]
			  ,[YYYYMMDD]  
			  ,[QTY] AS PLAN_QTY
			  ,(SELECT TOP 1 BOD_ID 
			   FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V WITH(NOLOCK)
			  WHERE DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID  
				AND FROM_SITE = CASE WHEN R.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL OR R.PLANT_SITE_ID = '' THEN 'KR012031-P' ELSE  R.PLANT_SITE_ID END
				AND TO_SITE  = R.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                AND INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
			  ORDER BY 
				 PRIORITY ASC
			  )  AS BOD_ID  
			  ,[CREATED_BY]
			  ,[PLANT_SITE_ID] AS ORG_PLANT_SITE_ID
			 FROM [dbo].DM_PLN_MKT_FCST R WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE R.DIVISION_ID  = '82' 
			  AND R.QTY    >= 1
			  AND R.ATTRIBUTE9 IS NULL 
			  AND R.YYYYMMDD   >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, getdate(), 112)
			  AND R.MEASURE   = 'BNPIn'
		 ) as X
		 where x.BOD_ID is null

 ) ma
 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT a.*, b.transport_mode
					    FROM scp_mst_bod a
						INNER JOIN scp_mst_distribution_route b ON a.ROUTE_ID = b.ROUTE_ID				
					) bo ON  bo.division_id   = ma.division_id
 				     AND bo.to_site       = ma.SCM_SITE_ID
 					 AND bo.incoterms     = ma.incoterms
 					 AND bo.from_site     = ma.PLANT_SITE_ID
 LEFT OUTER JOIN scp_mst_distribution_route ro  ON bo.route_id = ro.route_id
 WHERE 1=1
 		AND  bo.route_id IS NULL		
 		AND ma.division_id    IN ('40','81','82')		
		AND ma.PLANT_SITE_ID in (		
			SELECT	SCM_SITE_ID
			FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)	
			WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'	
			AND    A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'	
		)		
		AND ma.SCM_SITE_ID in (		
			SELECT	 SCM_SITE_ID
			FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)	
			WHERE   A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'	
		)		
		AND ma.incoterms in (		
			SELECT B.SEGMENT1	
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A WITH(NOLOCK)	
			INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE  AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'	
			WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'	
			  AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	
		)		
 ) T
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_mst_site s WHERE s.division_id = t.division_id AND s.scm_site_id = t.from_site_code AND s.valid_yn = 'Y' AND s.osp_yn = 'Y' AND s.operation_group = 'A')
) A

select '' USER_ID, '' USER_NAME, '' mobile_phone, 'choiya2@lgespartner.com' email_addr, 'KO' language_code
      ,Program_Name segment1, Execute_Date segment2, start_count segment3, VALID segment4, '' segment5, '' segment6, '' segment7, '' segment8, '' segment9, '' segment10
      ,'Program_Name' column1, 'Execute_Date' column2, N'총 실행횟수' column3, N'비정상 종료 실행횟수' column4, '' column5, '' column6, '' column7, '' column8, '' column9, '' column10
  from ( 
    SELECT Program_Name
		,CONVERT(CHAR(8), LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112) 'Execute_Date'
		,isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'START' then 1 end),0) as 'start_count'
		,isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'START' then 1 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'END' then 1 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'INVALID' then 1 end),0) as 'Valid'
		, COUNT(1) % 2 AS 'Odd_Check'
  FROM dbo.SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH WITH(NOLOCK) 
  WHERE 1=1 
 AND PROGRAM_NAME LIKE '%DM%' AND PROGRAM_NAME NOT LIKE 'SCM%' AND PROGRAM_NAME NOT LIKE 'UP_%'
 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8), LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112) >= CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE()-1,112)
 AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE < DATEADD(minute,-10,GETDATE())  /* 정시에 수행되는 작업의 종료를 Catch하지 못하여 10분전까지로 시간을 설정 */
 AND LOG_TYPE in ('START','END','INVALID')  /* validation 으로 강제종료시킨 INVALID 도 추가*/
GROUP BY PROGRAM_NAME,CONVERT(CHAR(8), LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112)
having isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'START' then 1 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'END' then 1 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when LOG_TYPE = 'INVALID' then 1 end),0) > 0

     ) z
group by  Program_Name, Execute_Date, start_count, VALID

	'' AS USER_ID

  FROM (
-- 40
SELECT distinct
	   m.division_id
      ,m.plant_site_id
      ,dbo.FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION (m.division_id, m.plant_site_id ) AS plant_site_name
      ,m.operation_group_id
      ,m.operation_id
	  ,m.operation_id as operation_name
	  ,m.model_site
      ,m.item_id
      ,isnull(m.nick_name,'-') as nick_name
FROM(
			-- Project Route 화면에 등록된 모델중 Tact Time Master에 없는 모델 조회
			-- scp_mst_tact_time 에 등록되면 리스트에서 제외
			SELECT DISTINCT
				   a.division_id
				  ,a.plant_site_id
				  ,dbo.fn_get_item_operation_group(a.division_id, a.item_id) AS operation_group_id -- item_sn 테이블에 미등록된 site 경우 값을 가져올 수 없어 function을 통해 가져옴
				  ,substring(i.scp_flow_id,1,5) AS operation_id
				  ,i.site_id AS model_site
				  ,a.item_id
				  ,i.nick_name
				  ,null AS line_id
				  ,null AS priority
				  ,null AS tact_time
				  ,null AS yield
				  ,null AS daily_capacity
				  ,null AS valid_yn
				  ,null AS created_by
				  ,null AS creation_date
				  ,null AS last_updated_by
				  ,null AS last_update_date
				  , 'I' as input_status
			FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN scm_mst_item_sn i (NOLOCK) ON a.division_id = i.division_id 
														AND a.item_id = i.item_id 
														AND i.site_id = ( select site_id from scm_mst_plant_sn s (NOLOCK) where s.division_id = a.division_id and s.plant_id = dbo.fn_scm_split(a.plant_site_id,1,'-') )
				JOIN SCM_MST_SITE b ON a.division_id = b.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = b.scm_site_id
				inner join scp_mst_final_item fi with(nolock)  -- 20230710 활성화코드 대응 -- CP 제외
					    on fi.division_id = a.division_id
					   and fi.ITEM_ID     = a.item_id
					   and isnull(fi.attribute8,'') != 'CP' -- 2023.07.19 활성화코드 분리 해외 오픈 대응
			WHERE 1=1 
			  AND a.valid_yn    = 'Y'
			  AND b.osp_yn      = 'N' -- 외주 packer 제외
			  AND b.operation_group <> 'W' -- 20230403 AS Plant 건 제외
			  AND NOT EXISTS ( select 'X' from scp_mst_tact_time n (NOLOCK) 
								JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID=B.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID=N.DIVISION_ID AND LS.SITE_ID=B.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID=B.PLANT_ID
																		AND LS.OPERATION_ID=N.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID=N.LINE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y'
								where n.division_id = a.division_id 
								and n.plant_site_id = a.plant_site_id 
								and n.item_id = a.item_id )
			  -- MKT FCST 존재하는 모델만 조회
				AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X'
								   FROM scp_mst_final_item F WITH(NOLOCK)
								  WHERE F.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID
								    AND F.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID
									AND F.FCST_YN = UPPER('Y') 
									) 
			  AND a.division_id = '40'
			  AND i.flow_id not IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_TCO')
			 )m
WHERE 1=1
AND m.division_id = '40'
AND m.operation_group_id <>'E'
AND m.tact_time is null
AND substring(m.item_id,2,1) = CASE WHEN m.operation_group_id = 'A' Then 'C' ELSE substring(m.item_id,2,1)  END  --TCO Cell조회불가
) A

	  ,U.Email email_addr
	  ,'KO' language_code

	  ,CASE WHEN U.Language = 'KO' THEN LMD.SEGMENT2 ELSE LMD.SEGMENT3 END SEGMENT3

	  ,A.REJECT_REASON SEGMENT5

	  ,'' SEGMENT7
	  ,'' SEGMENT8
	  ,'' SEGMENT9
	  ,'' SEGMENT10

	  ,'Division' COLUMN2
	  ,'Approval Result' COLUMN3
	  ,'Approval Date' COLUMN4
	  ,'Remark' COLUMN5
	  ,'' COLUMN6
	  ,'' COLUMN7
	  ,'' COLUMN8
	  ,'' COLUMN9
	  ,'' COLUMN10, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
FROM SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN TB_FX_User U WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.USER_ID = U.UserID AND U.UseYN = 'Y'
INNER JOIN TB_FX_GroupInfo G WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.GROUP_ID = G.GroupID AND G.UseYN = 'Y'
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DIV WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.DIVISION_ID = DIV.DIVISION_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PLANT_SN PS WITH(NOLOCK)  ON A.PLANT_ID = PS.PLANT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.PLANT_ID = V.VENDOR_CODE
LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FX_UserGroupInfo GUER WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.GROUP_ID = GUER.GroupID AND A.USER_ID = GUER.UserID 
INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER LM WITH(NOLOCK) ON LM.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AUTH_REPUEST_STATUS' AND LM.VALID_YN = 'Y'
INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LMD WITH(NOLOCK) ON LM.LOOKUP_TYPE = LMD.LOOKUP_TYPE AND A.APPROVAL_RESULT = LMD.SEGMENT1 AND LMD.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE A.APPROVAL_RESULT IN ('APPROVED','REJECT')
AND ((RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 100), 2) = 'AM' AND A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= (DATEADD(HOUR, -18, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) + ' 08:00:00'))) AND A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE < CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) + ' 08:00:00'))
      OR (RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 100), 2) = 'PM') AND A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) + ' 08:00:00') AND A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE < DATEADD(HOUR, 6, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 23) + ' 08:00:00')))

select x.user_id USER_ID, x.user_id USER_NAME, '' mobile_phone, x.user_id email_addr, 'KO' language_code
      ,type segment1, division_id segment2, max(version_no) segment3, sum(v_count) segment4, sum(v_sum) segment5, sum(c_count) segment6, sum(c_qty) segment7, '' segment8, '' segment9, '' segment10
      ,'type' column1, 'division_id' column2, 'version_no' column3, 'original_count' column4, 'original_qty' column5, 'target_count' column6, 'target_qty' column7, '' column8, '' column9, '' column10

  from ( 
    select 'MKT_FCST' type, a.division_id, a.version_no, count(1) v_count, sum(qty)  v_sum, 0 c_count, 0 c_qty
     from dm_pln_mkt_fcst_c a with(nolock)
      ,(
      select DIVISION_ID, max(version_no) max_version_no
        from dm_pln_mkt_fcst_c  with(nolock)
      where version_no like 'MF_W%' 
      group by DIVISION_ID
       )  b
     where measure in ( 'MKT_FCST' /*,'CUST_FCST'*/) 
    and a.version_no = b.max_version_no 
    and a.DIVISION_ID = b.DIVISION_ID
   group by  a.division_id , a.version_no
   UNION ALL
   select 'MKT_FCST' type, division_id, 'current',0 v_count, 0v_sum,   count(1), sum(qty)  
     from dm_pln_mkt_fcst  with(nolock)
    where [YYYYMMDD] >=  CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) 
     and measure in ( 'MKT_FCST'/*,'CUST_FCST'*/) group by  division_id
   UNION ALL
    select 'SALES_PLAN' type, a.division_id, a.version_no, count(1) v_count, sum(qty)  v_sum, 0 c_count, 0 c_qty
     from dm_pln_sales_plan_c a  with(nolock)
      ,(
      select DIVISION_ID, max(version_no) max_version_no
        from dm_pln_sales_plan_c   with(nolock)
      where version_no like 'SP_W%' 
      group by DIVISION_ID
       )  b
     where measure in ( 'MKT_FCST'/*,'CUST_FCST'*/) 
    and a.version_no = b.max_version_no 
    and a.DIVISION_ID = b.DIVISION_ID
   group by  a.division_id , a.version_no
   UNION ALL
   select 'SALES_PLAN' type, division_id, 'current',0 v_count, 0v_sum,   count(1), sum(qty)  
     from dm_pln_sales_plan   with(nolock)
    where [YYYYMMDD] >=  CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) 
     and measure in ( 'MKT_FCST'/*,'CUST_FCST'*/) group by  division_id
   UNION ALL
    select 'MKT_FCST_RESULT' type, a.division_id, a.version_no, count(1) v_count, sum(qty)  v_sum, 0 c_count, 0 c_qty
     from DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT_C a with(nolock)
      ,(
      select DIVISION_ID, max(version_no) max_version_no
        from DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT_C  with(nolock)
      where version_no like 'MF_W%' 
      group by DIVISION_ID
       )  b
     where measure in ( 'MKT_FCST'/*,'CUST_FCST'*/) 
    and a.version_no = b.max_version_no 
    and a.DIVISION_ID = b.DIVISION_ID
    and [YYYYMMDD] <  CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) 
   group by  a.division_id , a.version_no
   UNION ALL
   select 'MKT_FCST_RESULT' type, division_id, 'current',0 v_count, 0v_sum,   count(1), sum(qty)  
     from DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT  with(nolock)
    where [YYYYMMDD] < CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) 
     and measure in ( 'MKT_FCST'/*,'CUST_FCST'*/) group by  division_id
   UNION ALL
    select 'SALES_PLAN_RESULT' type, a.division_id, a.version_no, count(1) v_count, sum(qty)  v_sum, 0 c_count, 0 c_qty
     from dm_pln_sales_plan_result_c a  with(nolock)
      ,(
      select DIVISION_ID, max(version_no) max_version_no
        from dm_pln_sales_plan_result_c   with(nolock)
      where version_no like 'SP_W%' 
      group by DIVISION_ID
       )  b
     where measure in ( 'MKT_FCST'/*,'CUST_FCST'*/) 
    and a.version_no = b.max_version_no 
    and a.DIVISION_ID = b.DIVISION_ID
    and [YYYYMMDD] <  CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) 
   group by  a.division_id , a.version_no
   UNION ALL
   select 'SALES_PLAN_RESULT' type, division_id, 'current',0 v_count, 0v_sum,   count(1), sum(qty)  
     from dm_pln_sales_plan_result   with(nolock)
    where [YYYYMMDD] < CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)

		, ( CASE WHEN t.item_id = '-' THEN 'Total' ELSE t.item_id END ) AS item_id

		, t.valid_yn
		, t.created_by
		, t.creation_date
		, t.last_updated_by
		, t.last_update_date
	FROM(
		-- outsourcing 모델 조회
		SELECT DISTINCT a.division_id, a.scm_site_id, b.vendor_code,  c.item_id, d.daily_capa_qty, d.valid_yn, d.created_by, d.creation_date, d.last_updated_by, d.last_update_date
		FROM scm_mst_site a
		JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR b ON a.plant_id = b.vendor_code
		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID and a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA d ON a.division_id = d.division_id and a.scm_site_id = d.plant_site_id and c.item_id = d.item_id
		WHERE a.osp_yn ='Y'
		AND a.valid_yn ='Y'
		AND c.valid_yn ='Y'
		UNION
		-- 업체 Total 표시를 위해 '-' 로 추가 
		SELECT  DISTINCT a.division_id, a.scm_site_id, b.vendor_code, d.item_id, d.daily_capa_qty, d.valid_yn, d.created_by, d.creation_date, d.last_updated_by, d.last_update_date
		FROM scm_mst_site a

		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID and a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA d ON a.division_id = d.division_id and a.scm_site_id = d.plant_site_id
		WHERE a.osp_yn ='Y'
		AND a.valid_yn ='Y'
		AND c.valid_yn ='Y'
		AND d.item_id = '-'
		UNION
		-- SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA 에 없는 등록이 필요한 모델 조회
		SELECT  DISTINCT a.division_id, a.scm_site_id, b.vendor_code, '-',null,null,null,null,null,null
		FROM scm_mst_site a

		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID and a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
		WHERE a.osp_yn ='Y'
		AND a.valid_yn ='Y'

 ,CASE WHEN RIGHT(t.from_site_code,1) = 'E' THEN (SELECT top 1 ISNULL(VMI_YN,'N') FROM scm_mst_site WHERE scm_site_id = t.to_site_code )
  ELSE (SELECT ISNULL(VMI_YN,'N') FROM scm_mst_site WHERE division_id =t.division_id AND scm_site_id = t.to_site_code ) END vmi_yn

 		,ma.from_country

         ,dbo.FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC ('TRANSPORT_MODE_CODE' , ma.transport_mode ) AS transport_mode
  		,bo.safety_stock, bo.priority

  		,ro.days_thu

  		,CASE WHEN (ro.FROM_CITY = ma.from_city) AND (ro.TO_CITY = ma.to_city) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END route_chk

  										   FROM  scm_mst_site a

							group by DIVISION_ID
					) vv

					and a.VERSION_NO        = vv.VERSION_NO	)

		and a.attribute1		>= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) -- 당주 월요일 YYYYMMDD
		group by a.DIVISION_ID, a.scm_site_id, a.item_id, substring(a.attribute1,1,6)

				and s.vmi_yn			= 'N'

			  INNER JOIN scm_mst_site_item m with(nolock)

				and a.PROJECT_CODE		= m.PROJECT_CODE
				and a.item_id			= m.item_id
				and m.VALID_YN			= 'Y')
			  INNER JOIN (SELECT  DIVISION_ID,MAX(VERSION_NO) AS VERSION_NO
							FROM DM_MST_VERSION v WITH(NOLOCK)
								where v.DIVISION_ID IN ('81','82','40')
								and v.VERSION_TYPE      = 'MF_W'
								AND v.YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7*1, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)    -- 당주 월요일부터
								AND v.YYYYMMDD <= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, 0, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(getdate(), 'SUN')), 112)       -- 당주 일요일까지
							group by DIVISION_ID
					) vv
					on (a.DIVISION_ID		= vv.DIVISION_ID
					and a.VERSION_NO        = vv.VERSION_NO	)
		 where 1=1 
		AND A.DIVISION_ID  in ('81','82','40')   --input division_id
		and a.yyyymmdd			>= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) -- 당주 월요일 YYYYMMDD
		and a.measure			= 'MKT_FCST'
		and a.qty				> 0
		group by a.DIVISION_ID, a.scm_site_id, a.item_id, substring(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)
     ) z

      ,'Update Date'         AS COLUMN8

			 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), SL.CREATION_DATE, 120)	AS CREATION_DATE
			 , ''											AS UPDATE_DATE
			 , SL.DIVISION_ID
			 , SL.PLANT_ID
			 , SL.STORAGE_ID
			 , SL.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
			 , SL.VALID_YN
			 , ''			AS STORAGE_DESCRIPTION_OLD
			 , '' 			AS VALID_YN_OLD 
			 , 1			AS RN 
			 , 0	        AS HISTORY_SEQ
		 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SL WITH(NOLOCK)  
		WHERE 1=1
		  AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1   1
					   FROM dbo.SCM_MST_PLANT_SN P WITH(NOLOCK)
					  WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = SL.DIVISION_ID)
		  AND SL.CREATION_DATE	>= DATEADD(DAY, -1, CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(),112), 112))  -- 어제 등록
		UNION ALL
		-- 변경 
		SELECT 'MODIFY'					AS DV
			 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), SL.CREATION_DATE		,120)	AS CREATION_DATE
			 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), SH.HISTORY_CREATION_DATE,120)	AS UPDATE_DATE
			 , SL.DIVISION_ID
			 , SL.PLANT_ID
			 , SL.STORAGE_ID
			 , SL.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
			 , SL.VALID_YN
			 , SH.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION	AS STORAGE_DESCRIPTION_OLD
			 , SH.ATTRIBUTE1			AS VALID_YN_OLD 
			 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SL.creation_date
											  ,SL.DIVISION_ID
											  ,SL.PLANT_ID
											  ,SL.STORAGE_ID
											  ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), SH.HISTORY_CREATION_DATE, 112) -- 변경일자별 최종 변경건만 조회
									 ORDER BY  SH.HISTORY_SEQ DESC) 
										AS RN 
			 , SH.HISTORY_SEQ
		 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC_H SH WITH(NOLOCK)
			  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SLOC SL WITH(NOLOCK)
					  ON SL.DIVISION_ID = SH.DIVISION_ID
					 AND SL.STORAGE_ID  = SH.STORAGE_ID
					 AND SL.PLANT_ID    = SH.PLANT_ID 
		WHERE 1=1
		  AND SH.HISTORY_CREATION_DATE >= DATEADD(DAY, -1, CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(),112), 112))  -- 어제 변경(history생성일시)  
		  AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1   1
					   FROM dbo.SCM_MST_PLANT_SN P WITH(NOLOCK)
					  WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = SH.DIVISION_ID)

) BD
WHERE 1=1
  AND BD.RN = 1
